seoTitle: Free Video Trimmer: Cut a Clip Online, No Upload
metaDescription: Cut a video to a start and end time in your browser. Preview the clip, set the in and out points, and save only that section. Nothing is uploaded.
intro: Cuts a video file to the start and end times you choose and saves just that section. It runs in your browser and the file never leaves your device.
why:
Most online trimmers upload your video to a server. This one plays your file in a hidden video element, copies the chosen section to a canvas and records it with the browser recorder. Your footage stays on your device, which matters for private or large files.

It records in real time, so a 60 second clip takes about a minute and the tab must stay visible. The result is re-encoded, not a lossless cut, so it is best for sharing clips, not for archiving masters. Use the player and the "Use player time" buttons to set the points by eye.
howTo: Choose a video file and watch it in the preview player.
Pause on the first frame you want and press Use player time next to Start. Do the same for End.
Press Process and keep the tab open until it finishes.
Play the result and download it.

faq.a: No. The section is decoded and recorded again, so there is a small quality loss. A lossless cut needs a tool that copies the stream, which browsers cannot do for most files.

faq.q: Why does it take as long as the clip?
faq.a: The browser records the video as it plays. There is no faster path in the platform APIs.
